reviewer: daxin_reference; actual view_image calls for all four photographs

photos.author: Fayhoo
photos.view: Southwest oblique, relatively more of the west wing than in the 2022/2025 photographs.
features: Tall rounded southwest corner with narrow vertical ribs and rectangular multi-pane windows; stepped pale upper crown and a stack of projecting round-edged disks on the corner axis.
Both lower street wings are visible, with repetitive vertical window strips and upper open terrace/gallery bays below pierced ornamental bands and triangular teeth.
Broad ground-level canopy wraps the corner above dark storefront openings; trees and advertisement panels obscure some lower openings.

Simpler northern continuation at the left and curved advertising building at the right are visually distinct from the ornate historic block; final ownership is established separately by the footprint review.
limits: Does not show north/east rear elevations, courtyard or roof plan.
Large rooftop green letters and side advertisement boards are transient; the 2025 image differs.
Description contains 1934, but this is a photograph caption, not independent completion-year evidence.
photos.review_method: Actual view_image of the downloaded local original JPEG by daxin_reference; not inferred from title or metadata

photos.author: Suicasmo
photos.view: Southwest oblique, relatively more of the south wing.
features: Current pale upper crown has stepped piers, narrow top openings, angled upper window heads and the projecting cylindrical/stacked-disc corner ornament. The large roof letters present in 2016/2022 are absent in this image.
South wing shows three open upper gallery bays, pale geometric pierced friezes, short parapet pieces and a row of triangular crest teeth between taller piers.
Long pale vertical inset strips terminate in semicircular-headed windows; adjacent repeated bays have slender ribs and recessed rectangular grey-blue metal windows.
Cream/buff face material and contrasting pale crown are observable; exact brick/ceramic dimensions and colorimetry cannot be measured from this photograph.
Ground canopy, dark glazed shop fronts and both street returns are visible; adjoining east advertising volume remains a separate silhouette.
limits: Same broad southwest viewing family as the 2016/2022 photographs; not independent rear coverage.
Roof surfaces, internal courts and the north/east boundary elevations are not visible.
Street-level shop screens and trees hide some door and wall geometry.
photos.review_method: Actual view_image of the downloaded local original JPEG by daxin_reference; not inferred from title or metadata

photos.author: Shwangtianyuan
photos.view: Southwest/southern street approach, similar to 2025; photo camera coordinates recorded as 31.236626,121.470276.
features: South wing and rounded tall corner can be compared directly with 2025: repeated recessed windows, tall pale inset strips, three open upper bays and pierced top decoration persist.
Open upper galleries have actual visible depth and lower parapet, rather than a painted flat dark rectangle.
A rooftop commercial sign frame and disk logo are visible in 2022; their absence in 2025 means they are not treated as permanent historical mass.
The adjoining east rounded advertising building is adjacent but visually separate.
limits: Near-duplicate direction of 2025, not another facade.
File description says renovated in December 2017; this has not independently established which individual elements changed.
No proof of rear-wall openings, roof equipment positions, courtyard layout or measured heights.

photos.author: Baycrest
photos.view: More distant southwest junction context from the sunken pedestrian entrance area.
features: Historical ornate corner and lower south/west wings are recognizable as the same building, with other buildings immediately adjoining or behind it; their construction dates are not established here.
Large advertising panels obscure much upper-wing detail; this image helps street identity and silhouette comparison only.
limits: Low resolution and numerous advertisements; not used for exact window counts or current roof design.
Same southwest family; no rear/courtyard coverage.
Commercial and skyline objects behind the historic roof must not be merged into the modeled block.

cross_image_findings: 圆弧高转角、两低街翼、密集竖肋与矩形钢窗在2016/2022/2025均可辨识。
翼顶有三角齿冠、几何镂空饰带及真实退入的敞廊；可建几何而不以照片贴图代替。
高转角顶层浅色阶梯冠、窄顶部开口与叠圆片装饰可辨；完整顶面平面仍不可见。
大幅商业招牌和广告随年份改变，2025主转角顶部没有2016/2022的大绿招牌；排除瞬时商业附属物。
四张照片不能核准北东背面、内院或屋顶设备；相邻楼体不因同框就成为历史主楼组成，其建造年代未核。

scope_decision.subject: 独立的旧大新公司历史主楼外观，不代表整个第一百货商业中心。
scope_decision.recommended_modeled_extent: 以另行核验的旧主楼源足迹表现整体外观；南/西街面按实际照片，北/东隐藏面和屋顶仅作明确标注的简化估计。
scope_decision.excluded: 现有独立北侧B馆、东侧C馆及其他商业中心附楼、连接体、室内与招牌广告不自动并入；B/C馆建造年代未核。
scope_decision.photo_coverage: 四张都属于西南街角方向；2016偏西、2022/2025偏南、2006较远。不是四个独立立面。
scope_decision.adjoining_BC_date_note: 照片与地图源区分楼体，不证明B/C馆建造年代；本件排除依据是独立范围，而非已确认的年代差异。

not_proven: 所有开间与窗格的精确计数
真实屋面与天井是否及如何贯通
现有相邻楼和连接体的外观完成及建造年代
